rules: A historical finding becomes open BD only after current-code confirmation.
Semantically identical failure causes share one durable root ID across PRs and repos.
Root IDs are never renumbered when the census expands.
DONE requires merged/current-code survival evidence; CONTROL additionally requires a prevention/detection measure plus distinct-source repeat evidence.
A second observed occurrence across a distinct PR, SHA, or repo promotes the root to REX-managed recurrence.
Negative, rejected, invalidated, and superseded evidence is retained rather than deleted.
Synthetic or inferred counts are not PCA/BT eligible.

roots.title: Derive observed REX verbs from completed dispositions, not requested actions
roots.current_code_evidence: crew_rex_bridge.py builds observed_verbs from requested_action values
roots.done_when: runtime report counts ASSIMILATE/PRUNE/BRIDGE only from accepted completed disposition evidence

roots.title: Enforce CREW_REX report_required_fields including timestamp
roots.current_code_evidence: contract requires timestamp but bridge does not enforce all declared required fields
roots.done_when: missing required crew-report fields fail closed and temporal ordering validates

roots.title: Require the complete L0-L6 competency scale
roots.current_code_evidence: validate_crew_system.py checks L6 rather than exact L0..L6 set
roots.done_when: validator requires exact L0..L6 key set

roots.title: Validate every telemetry event_required field
roots.current_code_evidence: validate_crew_telemetry.py validates selected values but not every telemetry.event_required key
roots.done_when: all event_required keys are fail-closed before value checks

roots.title: Align role trial records with policy trial requirements
roots.current_code_evidence: ROLE_TRIALS fields differ from ROLE_GAP_POLICY trial_requirements
roots.done_when: trial records and policy share one enforced contract

roots.title: Evaluate applicable REX before workload execution and acceptance
roots.current_code_evidence: run_measured_tasks.py and frontier runners still materialize blocking_rex_ids as empty after workload execution
roots.done_when: preflight executes before payload, blocking REX vetoes payload, receipt binds evaluated checks and a distinct-SHA repeat passes

roots.title: Classify repeated REX from history rather than always NEW
roots.current_code_evidence: run_measured_tasks.py assigns recurrence_level NEW without consulting prior provenance-bound history
roots.done_when: postflight recurrence derives from prior occurrences and distinguishes NEW/RECURRING/PERSISTENT/REGRESSION

roots.title: Compute PCA readiness variance from eligible measured rows only
roots.current_code_evidence: build_measured_allocation.py computes varying features from all rows before selecting allocation_eligible rows
roots.done_when: eligible rows are selected before every PCA readiness statistic

roots.title: Retain validated rejected runtime evidence in canonical history
roots.current_code_evidence: canonical evidence-return validation accepts only successful/ACCEPT observations
roots.done_when: validated negative observations are preserved without promotion and influence history/eligibility correctly

roots.title: Counterbalance paired allocation execution order
roots.current_code_evidence: frontier runner executes manifest order sequentially without randomized/counterbalanced pair order
roots.done_when: pair order is counterbalanced or randomized across repeated trials and order is recorded

roots.title: Fit Bradley-Terry abilities on the correct scale
roots.current_code_evidence: build_measured_allocation.py assigns each node full regularized log win/loss odds then centers, doubling two-node separation
roots.done_when: BT ability scale satisfies analytic fixtures and distinct-SHA repeat

roots.title: Derive pair winner and relative gap from raw recorded timings
roots.current_code_evidence: builder validates winner enum but does not recompute winner/relative_gap from seconds_a/seconds_b and tie threshold
roots.done_when: raw timings deterministically derive or fail-closed validate winner/gap

roots.title: Bind MissionControl exact SHA inside Ring2 scout receipt
roots.current_code_evidence: Ring2 scout receipt records candidate SHA but not checked-out MissionControl SHA
roots.done_when: receipt records and validates both candidate SHA and MissionControl source SHA
